scope: 35 targeted, dependent development cases; diagnostic only, not a general accuracy benchmark. Historical three-view and local expert-state strata are reported separately.

discard_loses_expert_spikes_next_action_.reason: Discard immediately removes expert-positive members. For these audited single-unit fragments KEEP is preferred; SPLIT is tolerable but not ideal, not a unique expert-action label.

all_members_terminal_noise_next_action_n.reason: KEEP retains terminal-noise members at this step and is scored as retention risk with count filters off; SPLIT delays rejection. This proxy does not assert that later rollout phases cannot discard them.

mixed_terminal_membership_next_action_no.reason: DISCARD loses expert spikes; KEEP retains known noise in the mixed state. SPLIT is the acceptable diagnostic action, without guaranteeing hierarchy separability or final rollout improvement.

acceptance.harmful_rate: v1 < v0 over all derived case-repeat observations
acceptance.expert_correct_count: v1 >= v0 - 1 over all recorded expert case-repeat observations (one total error allowance, not one per repeat)
acceptance.automatic_result: candidate_eligible_for_review, not final acceptance; human review of regressions remains required
acceptance.repeats: Pair by case_id and repeat index. Repeats are not independent samples. No majority-vote replacement in primary counts.
acceptance.incomplete: Report coverage and observed-only diagnostics; no acceptance decision or missing-action imputation.

consistency.pairwise: equal-action repeat pairs / all observed repeat pairs
consistency.unanimity: cases with all planned repeats present and identical / cases with all planned repeats present

strata: target_type + phase + image_layout + actual image count; phase2 local expert cases have three images, not four
changes: Any byte change invalidates existing runs; create a new run and repeat evaluation. Scorer must reject a scoring SHA256 mismatch.
